name: Demo day submit
purpose: Get the hackathon project tested, recorded and submitted.
description: Pull the latest code, run the tests, record a 2 minute demo and upload it to Devpost.

steps.action: In ~/code/app, pull main and run npm test. Report the number of passing and failing tests.
Open the app at localhost:3000 and record a 2 minute screen demo with QuickTime. Save it to the Demo folder in Google Drive.
steps.expected_result: A demo video of about 2 minutes is in the Drive folder. Report its link.

steps.action: In the browser, open our Devpost draft and add the demo link from the last step. Do not press Submit.
steps.expected_result: The draft shows the demo link and is not submitted.

never_automate: Pressing the final Submit button on Devpost
